articles.abstract_en: According to theory, “sin taxes” are welfare improving if consumers with low self-control respond at least as much to the tax as consumers with high self-control. We investigate empirically if demand response to soft drink and fat tax variations in Denmark depends on consumers’ self-control. We use a unique home-scan panel that includes a survey measure of self-control. When taxes increase, consumers with low self-control reduce purchases less strongly than consumers with high self-control. When taxes decrease, both groups increase their purchases similarly. The results show an asymmetry in price elasticities by self-control that is more pronounced when taxes increase. (JEL D12, D91, H25, H31, I12, I18, L66)
articles.abstract_cn: 根据理论，如果自我控制能力低的消费者对税收的反应至少与自我控制能力高的消费者一样大，那么“罪恶税”就能提高福利。我们通过实证研究，探讨丹麦软饮料税和脂肪税的变化对消费者需求的影响是否取决于消费者的自我控制能力。我们使用了一个独特的家庭扫描面板，其中包含自我控制的调查测量。当税收增加时，自我控制能力低的消费者减少购买的程度低于自我控制能力高的消费者。当税收减少时，两组消费者的购买增加情况相似。结果表明，价格弹性在自我控制方面存在不对称性，这种不对称性在税收增加时更为明显。(JEL D12, D91, H25, H31, I12, I18, L66)

articles.title_en: Special Economic Zones and Human Capital Investment: 30 Years of Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 经济特区与人力资本投资：来自中国的30年证据
articles.abstract_en: By exploiting the large quantity and rich variety of special economic zones (SEZs) in China, this study investigates how such zones affect human capital investment. Results show that SEZs significantly increase the local high school enrollment rate, but the impact varies across zone types: technology-oriented zones encourage education, while export-led zones discourage it. The increased job opportunities and wage premiums inside SEZs for employees with high school education increase high school enrollment, while such opportunities and wages for employees with middle school education decrease enrollment. A very small portion of the impact, if any, can be attributed to increased income. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31, O15, P23, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 通过利用中国经济特区数量多、种类丰富的特点，本研究考察了这些特区如何影响人力资本投资。结果表明，经济特区显著提高了当地高中入学率，但影响因特区类型而异：技术导向型特区鼓励教育，而出口导向型特区则抑制教育。特区内为高中教育程度员工提供的更多工作机会和工资溢价提高了高中入学率，而为初中教育程度员工提供的此类机会和工资则降低了入学率。影响中极小部分（如果有的话）可归因于收入增加。（JEL I21, I26, J24, J31, O15, P23, R32）

articles.title_en: Common Practice: Spillovers from Medicare on Private Health Care
articles.title_cn: 常见实践：医疗保险对私人医疗保健的溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: Efforts to raise US health-care productivity have proceeded slowly, potentially due to the fragmentation of payment across insurers. Each insurer’s efforts to improve care could influence how doctors practice for other insurers, leading to unvalued externalities. We study a randomized letter intervention by Medicare to curtail overuse of antipsychotics. The letters did not mention private insurance but reduced prescribing to these patients by 12 percent, much like the 17 percent effect in Medicare. We cannot reject onefor-one spillovers, suggesting that physicians use similar medical practice styles across insurers. Our findings establish that insurers can affect health care well outside their direct purview. (JEL D24, G22, I11, I13, I18)
articles.abstract_cn: 提高美国医疗保健生产力的努力进展缓慢，这可能是由于各保险公司之间支付的碎片化。每个保险公司改善护理的努力可能会影响医生对其他保险公司的实践方式，导致未被重视的外部性。我们研究了医疗保险为遏制抗精神病药物过度使用而进行的随机信件干预。这些信件未提及私人保险，但将这些患者的处方减少了12%，与医疗保险中17%的效果非常相似。我们不能拒绝一对一溢出效应，这表明医生在不同保险公司之间使用相似的医疗实践风格。我们的发现确立了保险公司可以影响其直接管辖范围之外的医疗保健。(JEL D24, G22, I11, I13, I18)

articles.title_en: Spending Responses to High-Frequency Shifts in Payment Timing: Evidence from the Earned Income Tax Credit
articles.title_cn: 支出对付款时间高频变化的反应：来自劳动所得税抵免的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the spending response to tax refunds for Earned Income Tax Credit recipients using a novel dataset combining transaction-based measures of retail spending with administrative IRS data on tax refunds. Our dataset allows us to exploit variation in the timing of EITC refunds, including changes related to the 2017 PATH Act, along with cross-state differences in refund magnitudes to identify spending responses. Results show EITC recipients spend about $0.30 per refund dollar ($1,150 for the average refund) within just two weeks of issuance, suggesting stimulus targeted at this population may provide a quick boost to aggregate demand. (JEL D12, E32, G51, H24, I38, K34)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究使用一个新颖的数据集，将基于交易的零售支出指标与国税局的行政退税数据相结合，探讨了所得税抵免受益人对退税的支出反应。我们的数据集使我们能够利用 EITC 退款时间的变化，包括与 2017 PATH 法案相关的变化，以及退款幅度的跨州差异来确定支出反应。结果显示，EITC 领取者在发放后的短短两周内，每美元退款支出约为 0.30 美元（平均退款为 $1,150 美元），这表明针对这一人群的刺激措施可能会迅速提振总需求。 (JEL D12、E32、G51、H24、I38、K34)

articles.title_en: How Social Security Reform Affects Retirement and Pension Claiming
articles.title_cn: 社会保障改革如何影响退休和养老金领取
articles.abstract_en: A reform increasing the full retirement age (FRA) by one year leads to larger than expected delays in pension claiming and retirement, while making late claiming more lucrative leads to a smaller than expected delay in pension claiming. Survey evidence shows people view the FRA as the “normal” retirement age and prefer to couple pension claiming and retirement decisions together, even though these two decisions are not coupled through social security provisions. Two mechanisms are at work: reference dependence with loss aversion in pension claiming, and spillovers from pension claiming on retirement choices. The FRA increase leads to large government savings. (JEL H55, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 一项将完全退休年龄（FRA）提高一年的改革导致养老金领取和退休的延迟幅度大于预期，而提高延迟领取的吸引力则导致养老金领取的延迟幅度小于预期。调查证据显示，人们将FRA视为“正常”退休年龄，并倾向于将养老金领取和退休决策结合起来，尽管这两项决策在社会保障条款中并未相互关联。两种机制在起作用：养老金领取中的参考依赖与损失厌恶，以及养老金领取对退休选择的溢出效应。FRA的提高带来了巨大的政府储蓄。（JEL H55, J26）

articles.title_en: Investing in Ex Ante Regulation: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Patent Examination
articles.title_cn: 投资于事前监管：来自药品专利审查的证据
articles.abstract_en: We explore how the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office may improve the quality of issued patents on “secondary” drug features by giving examiners more time to review drug patent applications. Our findings suggest that current time allocations are causing examiners to issue low-quality secondary patents on the margin. To assess the merits of expanding ex ante scrutiny of drug patent applications at the agency, we set forth estimates of the various gains and losses associated with giving examiners more time, including reduced downstream litigation costs and added personnel expenses, along with both the static gains and dynamic innovation losses associated with earlier generic entry. (JEL K11, L65, O31, O34, O38)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了美国专利商标局如何通过给予审查员更多时间审查药品专利申请，来提高“次要”药物特征专利的质量。我们的研究结果表明，当前的时间分配正导致审查员在边际上颁发低质量的次要专利。为了评估在该机构扩大药品专利申请事前审查的利弊，我们提出了与给予审查员更多时间相关的各种收益和损失的估计，包括减少下游诉讼成本和增加人员开支，以及早期仿制药进入带来的静态收益和动态创新损失。（JEL K11, L65, O31, O34, O38）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Organizational Boundaries on Health Care Coordination and Utilization
articles.title_cn: 组织边界对医疗协调和利用的影响
articles.abstract_en: We measure organizational concentration—the distribution of a patient’s health care across organizations—to examine how firm boundaries affect health care efficiency. First, when patients move to regions where outpatient visits are typically concentrated within a small set of firms, their health care utilization falls. Second, for patients whose primary care providers (PCPs) exit the market, switching to a PCP with 1 standard deviation higher organizational concentration reduces utilization by 21 percent. This finding is robust to controlling for the spread of health care across providers. Increases in organizational concentration predict improvements in diabetes care and are not associated with greater use of emergency department or inpatient care. (JEL D22, D23, D24, I11, J14, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量组织集中度——患者在不同组织间医疗服务的分布——以考察企业边界如何影响医疗效率。首先，当患者迁移到门诊就诊通常集中在一小部分企业的地区时，其医疗利用下降。其次，对于其主要护理提供者（PCP）退出市场的患者，转向组织集中度高出1个标准差的PCP会使医疗利用减少21%。这一发现在控制医疗服务在提供者间的分散程度后依然稳健。组织集中度的提高预示着糖尿病护理的改善，并且与急诊或住院护理的更多使用无关。（JEL D22, D23, D24, I11, J14, R32）

articles.title_en: Corporate Tax Breaks and Executive Compensation
articles.title_cn: 公司税收减免与高管薪酬
articles.abstract_en: I analyze the effect of two corporate tax breaks, bonus depreciation and the Domestic Production Activities Deduction (DPAD), on executive compensation in publicly traded US firms. I find both tax breaks significantly increase executive compensation. For every dollar a firm benefits from the tax breaks, compensation of the firm’s top five highest-paid executives increases by $0.17 to $0.25. The tax breaks increase compensation primarily in firms with weaker governance structures, suggesting the compensation response is driven by executive rent extraction. (JEL D22, G34, H25, M12, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我分析了两种公司税收减免，即奖金折旧和国内生产活动扣除（DPAD），对美国上市公司高管薪酬的影响。我发现这两种税收减免都显著增加了高管薪酬。公司从税收减免中每受益一美元，其薪酬最高的五位高管的薪酬就会增加0.17至0.25美元。税收减免主要在治理结构较弱的公司中增加薪酬，这表明薪酬反应是由高管租金提取驱动的。（JEL D22, G34, H25, M12, M52）

articles.title_en: Incentivizing School Attendance in the Presence of Parent-Child Information Frictions
articles.title_cn: 在亲子信息摩擦存在的情况下激励上学
articles.abstract_en: Many countries use CCTs targeted to parents to promote schooling. Attendance conditions may work through two channels: incentivization and information. If children have private information, (i) providing attendance information to parents may increase attendance inexpensively relative to CCTs and (ii) it may be more effective to incentivize children, who have full information, than parents. Tackling both questions in a unified experimental setting, we find that information alone improves parental monitoring and has a large effect relative to our CCT. Incentivizing children is at least as effective as incentivizing parents––importantly, not because parents were able to appropriate transfers to children. (JEL D82, D83, I21, I22, I28, L31, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家使用针对家长的现金转移支付（CCT）来促进就学。出勤条件可能通过两个渠道起作用：激励和信息。如果儿童拥有私人信息，（i）向家长提供出勤信息可能相对于CCT以较低成本增加出勤率，（ii）激励拥有完全信息的儿童可能比激励家长更有效。在统一的实验环境中解决这两个问题，我们发现仅信息就能改善家长监督，并且相对于我们的CCT具有较大的效果。激励儿童至少与激励家长同样有效——重要的是，这不是因为家长能够挪用转移给儿童的资源。（JEL D82, D83, I21, I22, I28, L31, O15）

articles.title_en: The Costs of Misaligned Incentives: Energy Inefficiency and the Principal-Agent Problem
articles.title_cn: 激励错位的成本：能源效率与委托-代理问题
articles.abstract_en: In many settings, misaligned incentives and inadequate monitoring lead employees to take self-interested actions. This paper identifies and quantifies the costs of this principal-agent problem in the context of an energy efficiency appliance replacement program. I show that contractors (agents) hired by the electric utility (the principal) increase their compensation by intentionally misreporting program data to authorize the replacement of nonqualified refrigerators. I estimate that each unqualified replacement reduces program benefits by $106 and saves 30 percent less electricity than replacements that follow program guidelines. The same program without a principal-agent distortion would increase program benefits by $60 per replacement. (JEL D82, L68, L94, L98)
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多情境下，激励错位和监管不足导致员工采取自利行为。本文在能效电器更换项目的背景下，识别并量化了这种委托-代理问题的成本。我展示了由电力公司（委托人）雇佣的承包商（代理人）通过故意虚报项目数据以授权更换不合格冰箱，从而增加其报酬。我估计，每次不合格更换使项目收益减少106美元，并且比遵循项目指南的更换节省的电力少30%。没有委托-代理扭曲的同一项目，每次更换将使项目收益增加60美元。（JEL D82, L68, L94, L98）

articles.title_en: Interregional Contact and the Formation of a Shared Identity
articles.title_cn: 跨区域接触与共同身份的形成
articles.abstract_en: We study the long-run effects of contact with individuals from other regions in early adulthood on preferences, beliefs, and national identity. We combine a natural experiment, the random assignment of male conscripts to different locations throughout Spain, with tailored survey data. Being randomly assigned to complete military service outside of one’s region of residence fosters contact with conscripts from other regions and increases sympathy and trust toward people from the region of service, as measured decades later. We also observe a long-lasting increase in identification with Spain for individuals originating from regions with strong peripheral nationalism. (JEL D12, D83, D91, J45, R23, Z13.)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了成年早期与来自其他地区的个体接触对偏好、信念和国家认同的长期影响。我们将一个自然实验——男性应征者被随机分配到西班牙各地服役——与定制的调查数据相结合。被随机分配到居住地区以外的地方完成兵役，促进了与来自其他地区的应征者的接触，并在数十年后测量时，增加了对服役地区人群的同情和信任。我们还观察到，对于来自具有强烈地方民族主义地区的个体，其对西班牙的认同感出现了持久的增强。(JEL D12, D83, D91, J45, R23, Z13。)

articles.title_en: More than Words: Leaders’ Speech and Risky Behavior during a Pandemic
articles.title_cn: 不止于言辞：疫情期间领导人的讲话与风险行为
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether the anti-scientific rhetoric of modern populists can induce followers to engage in risky behavior. We gather electoral information, credit card expenses, and geo-localized mobile phone data for approximately 60 million devices in Brazil. After the president publicly dismissed the risks of the COVID-19 pandemic and challenged scientific recommendations, social distancing in pro-government localities declined. Consistently, credit card expenses increased immediately. Results are driven by localities with higher media penetration levels, active Twitter accounts, and a larger proportion of evangelical Christians, a critical electoral group. (JEL D72, D91, I12, I18, L82, O15, Z12)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了现代民粹主义者的反科学言论是否会诱导追随者从事风险行为。我们收集了巴西约60百万台设备的选举信息、信用卡支出和地理定位手机数据。在总统公开淡化COVID-19疫情风险并挑战科学建议后，亲政府地区的社交距离措施有所减少。与此一致，信用卡支出立即增加。结果由媒体渗透率较高、活跃推特账户较多以及福音派基督徒（一个关键的选举群体）比例较大的地区驱动。（JEL D72, D91, I12, I18, L82, O15, Z12）

articles.abstract_en: I study optimal carbon taxation in an analytic quantitative integrated assessment model (IAM) that links IAM components, parametric assumptions, and calibration approaches directly to their policy impacts. I show how temperature’s tax impact differs from that of previously analytically modeled carbon dynamics. Novel to analytic IAMs are a general economy, energy sectors including capital, varying degrees of substitutability across energy sources, an approximation of capital persistence, objective functions that include CES preferences and population weighting, and an explicit model of the greenhouse effect and ocean-atmosphere temperature dynamics. The paper enables economists to develop better-informed opinions about the social cost of carbon. (JEL H23, H43, Q54, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个分析性定量综合评估模型（IAM）中的最优碳税，该模型将IAM组成部分、参数假设和校准方法直接与其政策影响联系起来。我展示了温度对税收的影响与先前分析性建模的碳动态有何不同。分析性IAM的新颖之处包括：一般经济、包括资本在内的能源部门、能源来源之间不同程度的可替代性、资本持续性的近似、包括CES偏好和人口加权的目标函数，以及温室效应和海洋-大气温度动态的显式模型。本文使经济学家能够对社会碳成本形成更明智的观点。（JEL H23, H43, Q54, Q58）

articles.title_en: Immigrant Integration in the United States: The Role of Adult English Language Training
articles.title_cn: 美国移民融合：成人英语培训的作用
articles.abstract_en: The ability to speak and understand a host country’s primary language is strongly associated with measures of immigrant integration. We estimate the causal effects of English language training for adult immigrants on participants’ civic and economic outcomes using randomized enrollment lotteries from a public adult education program in Massachusetts. Participation doubles voter participation and increases annual earnings by $2,400 (56 percent). Increased tax revenue from earnings gains cover program costs over time, generating a 6 percent return for taxpayers. Ours is the first randomized evaluation of adult English language training as a standalone intervention in the United States. (JEL D72, H75, I21, I26, J15, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 掌握东道国主要语言的听说能力与移民融合的衡量指标密切相关。我们利用马萨诸塞州一项公共成人教育项目的随机入学抽签，估计了成人移民英语培训对参与者公民和经济结果的因果效应。参与使选民参与率翻倍，并使年收入增加2,400美元（56%）。收入增长带来的税收增加随时间推移覆盖了项目成本，为纳税人带来6%的回报。这是美国首次对成人英语培训作为独立干预措施进行的随机评估。（JEL D72, H75, I21, I26, J15, J24, J31）

articles.title_en: Voting for Democracy: Chile’s Plebiscito and the Electoral Participation of a Generation
articles.title_cn: 为民主投票：智利的全民公决与一代人的选举参与
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses the long-term consequences of voting for democracy. We study Chile’s 1988 plebiscite, which ended 15 years of dictatorship and reestablished democracy. Taking advantage of individual-level voting data, we implement an age-based regression discontinuity design comparing long-run registration and turnout rates across marginally eligible and ineligible individuals. We find plebiscite eligibility increased electoral turnout three decades later. The magnitude of the initial mobilization emerges as the mechanism. Plebiscite eligibility induced a sizable share of less-educated voters to register compared to other upstream elections. The event contributed to the emergence of one-party rule the 20 years following democratization. (JEL D72, D82, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了为民主投票的长期后果。我们研究了智利1988年的全民公决，该公决结束了15年的独裁统治并重建了民主。利用个人层面的投票数据，我们实施了一种基于年龄的断点回归设计，比较了勉强符合资格和不符合资格的个体的长期登记率和投票率。我们发现，公决资格在三十年后提高了选举投票率。初始动员的规模是其中的机制。与其他上游选举相比，公决资格促使相当大比例的受教育程度较低的选民进行登记。这一事件在民主化后的20年中促成了一党统治的出现。（JEL D72, D82, O17）

articles.title_en: College Enrollment and Mandatory FAFSA Applications: Evidence from Louisiana
articles.title_cn: 大学入学与强制FAFSA申请：来自路易斯安那州的证据
articles.abstract_en: I estimate the impact of a Louisiana state policy that mandated Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) applications as a high school graduation requirement. I find significant increases in FAFSA completion rates (19 percentage points), and my estimates imply an increase of 1–2 percentage points in college enrollment. There is suggestive evidence that these effects were more concentrated among lower-income students/schools, and merit-based state financial aid applications also increased. The design of this mandate implies that pushing students into action may be more effective than informational nudges and that localized support systems such as counselors are important for the success of a top-down policy. (JEL D91, H75, I21, I22, I23, I28)
articles.abstract_cn: 我评估了路易斯安那州一项将联邦学生援助免费申请（FAFSA）作为高中毕业要求的州政策的影响。我发现FAFSA完成率显著提高（19个百分点），我的估计表明大学入学率提高了1-2个百分点。有提示性证据表明，这些影响在低收入学生/学校中更为集中，且基于成绩的州财政援助申请也有所增加。这项任务的设计表明，推动学生采取行动可能比信息提示更有效，而辅导员等本地化支持系统对于自上而下政策的成功至关重要。（JEL D91, H75, I21, I22, I23, I28）
